newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to cut August wholesale product prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to cut August wholesale product prices.

text.p: Major refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Thursday it would cut wholesale oil product prices by 1.3 yen per litre, effective August 1.
It will be the fifth consecutive month the oil refiner has cut its monthly wholesale prices for its oil products.
Following the change, gasoline will be priced at 88.2 yen per litre, down from 89.5 yen in July, Idemitsu said in a statement.
Kerosene and gas oil will be priced at 34.2 yen per litre, down from 35.5 yen in the previous month.
The declines reflect a weaker yen against the dollar in June compared to May, as well as a decline in June-loading crude oil prices, the company said.
